parsed.post: New personal best! 0.992 -> 0.980. The combination of DEPTH=8, LR=0.06, and WD=0.1 seems to be a very strong foundation. I'll now test reducing the batch size to 262144 to see if more optimizer steps per 5 minutes can drive the loss even lower.
parsed.description: Reducing batch size from 524288 to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps within the 5-minute training budget.
